description: Agent Energy: submit a utility bill with its tariff and usage record: the tariff with its name, each rate with its id, name, component, unit (per kWh, per kW, per day or per month), time-of-use period, rate and for a tiered kWh rate the usage the tier starts after and ends at, and each tax with its id, name, rate and what it is charged on (all charges, energy or delivery); optionally the usage record with its period, total kWh, on-peak, mid-peak and off-peak kWh, peak kW, opening and closing meter reads and whether the read was actual or estimated; the bill with its id, period, each line with its id, description as printed, the tariff rate it charges, quantity, rate printed and amount, each tax line with its tariff tax, name and amount, the total and currency; and optionally the tolerance (0.01 when left out). The signed report gives the usage, every line beside the tariff rate times the recorded usage as matches, overcharged, undercharged, misstated, not_in_tariff, duplicate, unmatched or unread with its expected quantity, rate and amount, every tax line beside its recomputed amount, the totals billed, summed and recomputed with the difference, and counts them, and names errors: a line the tariff does not list, a repeated charge, a line or tax above its recomputed amount, a tax the tariff does not apply, a total above its lines and usage that disagrees with the meter reads; then an undercharge, a misprinted rate or quantity, a tariff charge or tax the bill leaves off, a total below its lines, time-of-use parts that do not add up, an estimated read and a period that differs from the usage record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A missing usage record, usage field, rate reference or total leaves the bill unverified. This recomputes one energy bill: an invoice against the job it belongs to is wever_invoice-check, one invoice summarized is wever_invoice-brief, a fee schedule against a general invoice is wever_fee-evidence-check and the plan itself against the plan quoted is wever_energy-tariff-check. Verdict energy_bill_errors, energy_bill_partial, energy_bill_unverified or energy_bill_clean. POST /api/energy-bill-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
